passage: Birds respond to winter in different ways. Some species, such as many warblers, fly hundreds or even thousands of kilometers south each fall. ______ others, such as northern cardinals, stay in the same area all year.
stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
steps: Sentence 3: others stay put, the opposite behavior.
"As a result" implies cause, "For instance" an example of the same idea, and "Likewise" similarity.
key: Opposite behaviors call for a contrast transition.
